source_text: Prevalent in parts of East Africa and the Horn (e.g., Somalia, Sudan), it is the most severe form, often necessitating deinfibulation for intercourse or delivery, though reinfibulation post-childbirth persists despite WHO discouragement due to exacerbated health risks. [9]
